name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-list-apart
why: the open cases' reads and audit row awaited one after another (a trip each) instead of in one batch

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-account-then-case
why: an account named by its id found first, its open case read after (a trip more on every case door)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-case-row-again
old: strikesLook(ctx, me, env, { target: row.id, row }),
why: a case read finds its account again inside strikesLook (a trip more)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-case-batch-apart
why: a case's lines, reports, kept claim, audit row and claim read back awaited one after another

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-look-then-batch
old: strikesLook(ctx, me, env, { target: row.id, row }),
new: await strikesLook(ctx, me, env, { target: row.id, row }),
why: a case's or strikes' record (strikesLook) read first, its batch sent after (a trip more on both doors)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-look-refusal-first
old: if (!canModerate(me, env)) return { error: 'not-moderator' }; // strikesLook's own refusal, asked before the batch below writes
new: if (false) return { error: 'not-moderator' }; // strikesLook's own refusal, asked before the batch below writes
why: a staff session's member always moderates (staff.js staffRole: Admin or Moderator, both canModerate), so strikesLook never refuses here today; the check is kept so a change to staffRole can never write a look's claim keep and audit row before the refusal

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-no-case-read
old: if (one && !open) return { error: 'no-case' }; // safety.js modCase's answer: the account has no open case this member may read
new: if (false) return { error: 'no-case' }; // safety.js modCase's answer: the account has no open case this member may read
why: an account with no open case read as one (the case door throws instead of answering no-case)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-act-row-again
why: an act finds its account again inside modAct (a trip more)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-closed-case-kept
why: an act that closed the open case still sends the claim's keep, which can change nothing (a trip more)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-cases-same-account-guard
old: const open = byId && row.id === body.target ? early : await openOf(row.id);
new: const open = byId ? early : await openOf(row.id);
why: findAccount by id answers that id's own row (players.id compares exactly), so the guard never fires today; it is kept so a change to findAccount's rule can never pair an account with another account's case

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-strikes-history-apart
why: a look's strikes counted, then its history read (a trip more on the panel's and the game's strikes and case doors)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-game-case-reads-apart
old: const [lines, reports] = await Promise.all(caseReads(db, c.id).map(async (st) => (await st.all())?.results ?? [])); // STAFF-PANEL-SPEED: one trip
new:
const [lines, reports] = [
    (await caseReads(db, c.id)[0].all())?.results ?? [],
    (await caseReads(db, c.id)[1].all())?.results ?? [],
  ]; // STAFF-PANEL-SPEED: one trip
why: the game's case read: its lines, then its reports (a trip more)

name: STAFF-PANEL-SPEED-press-then-case
old: click ? db.prepare('SELECT 1 AS y FROM mod_actions WHERE click = ?1').bind(click).first() : null,
new: click ? await db.prepare('SELECT 1 AS y FROM mod_actions WHERE click = ?1').bind(click).first() : null,
why: an act's press id checked, then its case read (a trip more on every Mute, Ban and Dismiss)
